summary.text: Yisak Worku is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 91 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his priorities include lowering living costs, health care, public schools and infrastructure.

paragraphs.text: Yisak Worku earned a high school diploma from the Harmony Science Academy of Euless and a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at Dallas in 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Worku said he was born in rural Asela, Ethiopia, and moved to Texas in 2005 after his family was selected for the U.S. Diversity Visa Program.
Worku advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.

In the survey, he said he supports legislation banning the mass corporate buyout of Texas homes, repealing school vouchers, and building more energy, rail and bus infrastructure to meet population growth.
He listed health care, tax reform, electoral and campaign finance reform, and technology regulation such as right to repair and internet privacy as policy interests.
